svg.title: BioFerris DNA logo, prototype 01
svg.desc: The original Ferris crab silhouette, including its spiked shell, claws and legs, formed entirely from readable G, T, C and A letter outlines. The whole body is filled with letters. No eyes, mouth, face, solid silhouette or background. All visible artwork uses the original Ferris orange, #F74C00.
svg.metadata: {"prototype": "01", "source": "https://rustacean.net/assets/rustacean-flat-happy.svg", "source_artist": "Karen Rustad Tölva", "source_license": "CC0", "source_sha256": "4da1947b1c9bae5b60d3bbee6aa933bc596bf8b84389f07c94eca2076caacf8f", "color": "#F74C00", "glyphs": "Outlined DejaVu Sans Mono Bold capitals", "glyphs_are_paths": true, "decorative_alphabet": "GTCA; not a biological sequence", "letter_count": 754, "glyph_cap_heights": [22.0, 14.0, 11.0], "background": "transparent", "silhouette": "Union of original colored Ferris shapes; face elements omitted."}
